$comment: Mission 1.57 sections 33 to 50. The verdict, the symbolic proofs, the selection and the one blocker that remains.
primary_outcome_statement: One apparatus pair passes every mandatory epistemic gate on first-party documentation from both sides, and neither apparatus is a registered source. Governance is the sole binding blocker, and it is an unasked question rather than a refusal.
why_selected: same external construct, established from both producers' own methodology documents rather than from the fact that the numbers look alike
independence established AFFIRMATIVELY and from both sides, which is the standard section 15 sets and the one every previous candidate in this repository has failed
the decisive evidence is a calibration scale rather than an organisation chart: the two programmes report on DIFFERENT reference scales, and a republished series carries the originator's scale
reliability reviewable on both sides, which is the gate Mission 1.47 learned to check first
the threshold can be PREREGISTERED, because nothing is held and no value was fetched
falsifiable in both directions, so the route can produce corroboration or contradiction without anybody predicting which
not_selected_by_elimination: Route A passes every mandatory gate on its own merits. Section 46 forbids selecting a route merely because the alternatives are worse, and that is not what happened here: Routes B and C were rejected on their own failures, and Route A would have been selected against a field of strong candidates.

the_reservation_the_operator_should_weig.detail: Atmospheric CO2 at a fixed site is not a quantity this product will ever research. Section 20 lists subject relevance as a PREFERENCE rather than a mandatory gate, and section 46's selection rule does not include it, so selection is permitted. It is still the thing most worth arguing about before the next mission runs.
the_reservation_the_operator_should_weig.what_the_route_is_actually_for: It is an APPARATUS route, not a research topic. Its purpose is to put two independent witnesses on one Claim so that the aggregation layer stops being algebraically identical to the B-2 pass-through baseline, which Mission 1.43 proved cannot happen with one provenance group however much evidence is added.
the_reservation_the_operator_should_weig.the_transferability_limitation: A calibration reference built entirely on a physical-science quantity may not transfer to the platform-mediated evidence this system actually scores. Reliability, revision behaviour and independence characteristics all differ. Mission 1.37 already restricted calibration to the ORDINAL construct for a related reason, and this limitation is of the same kind: what the route can establish is that the mechanism WORKS on real independent data, not what its parameters should be for a Wikipedia request count.
the_reservation_the_operator_should_weig.the_honest_alternative: There is none inside this portfolio. That is the finding below, not a gap in the search.

the_structural_finding.$comment: The most reusable output of this mission, and it explains why 29 registered sources yield zero pairs.
the_structural_finding.statement: A quantity that exists only because a platform recorded it can be measured only by that platform. A quantity that exists in the world independently of any measurer can be measured by more than one apparatus. Every source in this portfolio measures the first kind.
the_structural_finding.worked_through: Wikimedia's request counts exist because Wikimedia's servers logged them. Stack Overflow's question counts exist because Stack Overflow published them. GDELT's term frequencies exist because GDELT crawled a corpus and counted. TED's award totals exist because contracting authorities filed notices there. Each of these is the sole possible apparatus for its own quantity, and a second publication route is a second copy rather than a second measurement.
the_structural_finding.generalises: Mission 1.46 found that for official statistics the measurement happens once, at the national producer, and the international publishers are distribution layers. This mission finds the same shape one domain over: for platform data the measurement happens once, at the platform, and every API, dump and dashboard is a distribution layer. The two findings are one finding about where measurement actually occurs.
the_structural_finding.consequence_for_the_product: Corroboration and contradiction are structurally unavailable for platform-mediated evidence, and no amount of source acquisition changes that. What can be corroborated is a world quantity, and the portfolio currently holds exactly one family that names one -- national population -- which Mission 1.46 refuted on provenance.
the_structural_finding.why_this_is_not_a_counsel_of_despair: It is a search instruction. An independence-capable route must be sought among quantities that exist independently of their measurer, and this mission found one that qualifies on every epistemic gate.

symbolic_proofs.$comment: Section 33. Demonstrated against the CURRENT Claim identity, with no fixture reliability value promoted to a real one.

corroboration_case.setup: one Claim P with proposition key K; Evidence A SUPPORTS in provenance group A; Evidence B SUPPORTS in provenance group B; A independent of B
corroboration_case.grouping: _group_key puts a KNOWN_INDEPENDENT item in its OWN group keyed by evidence id, so two such rows on one Claim form TWO groups
corroboration_case.result: for gA, gB > 0, S > max(gA, gB)
corroboration_case.why_that_matters: max(gA, gB) is exactly what the B-2 pass-through baseline reports. This is the first shape in this repository that would make the full aggregator and B-2 differ.
corroboration_case.reliability_values_used: none; the proof is algebraic and no number was invented to run it

contradiction_case.setup: one Claim P with proposition key K; Evidence A SUPPORTS; Evidence B CONTRADICTS
contradiction_case.result: contradiction_strength > 0 and conflict_mass > 0 once reliability is resolvable
contradiction_case.current_state: claims_carrying_both_directions is 0, and Mission 1.56's CONTRADICTS row sits alone on its own Claim, so the arithmetic has still never run on real rows
contradiction_case.what_this_route_would_change: both witnesses target ONE proposition key, so a disagreement lands on one Claim rather than forming two

identity_check.the_two_witnesses_reach_one_claim_becaus: source_id, measurement value and evidence direction are all excluded from proposition identity by ADR-036, which Mission 1.56 verified on a real row

inferred_contract_fit.detail: TargetProposition already carries exactly these seven facts and nothing else, and the Mission 1.56 row proves the shape round-trips through proposition_key, the orchestrator and the database. A monthly mole-fraction threshold is the same shape as a daily request-change threshold.
inferred_contract_fit.cross_source_observed_revival_detail: Section 35. The correct shape is two OBSERVED observations feeding one INFERRED proposition, never a merge of two source-attributed OBSERVED Claims. SourceBoundary was not touched and the convergence contract was not widened.

conditions: no measurement value from either apparatus may enter this system before the registration exists
no measurement value was fetched during this feasibility mission
the threshold must be chosen from the metric's documented definition and range, never from a retrieved value
threshold_strategy.source_native_or_external_norm_available: NOT_ESTABLISHED. No published regulatory limit or service standard was identified for this metric at this site, and section 19 forbids manufacturing one from a median, an average or a round number.
threshold_strategy.the_scale_caveat_that_bears_on_the_thres: The two apparatuses report on different calibration scales, which differ by a small documented offset. A threshold placed close enough to the two future measurements for that offset to decide the comparison would manufacture a contradiction out of a scale difference. The next mission must place the threshold far enough from the plausible measurement range that a scale offset cannot flip it, and must record that reasoning BEFORE either value is retrieved.

future_independence_grouping_proof.$comment: Section 16. Feasibility only. No EvidenceIndependenceGroup was persisted, and none could be: no Evidence pair exists.
future_independence_grouping_proof.if: apparatus A and apparatus B later produce measurements of the same monthly mole fraction at the same site, and the documentation remains as reviewed
basis_references: apparatus B's first-party statement that it operates an independent sampling network rather than obtaining data from apparatus A
apparatus A's first-party methodology page describing apparatus B's measurements as independent
the two distinct published calibration scales
separate instruments and separate analysis laboratories documented on both sides
future_independence_grouping_proof.must_be_re_verified_at_review_time: Yes. This is a feasibility expectation recorded now, not a judgement recorded for later reuse. A reviewer performs the independence determination against the documents as they stand then.

reliability_scopes_prepared_not_assigned.$comment: Section 28. The five-field shape, so the eventual review has a question to answer. NO value is assigned.

apparatus_a_scope.record_kind_id: a mole-fraction observation kind that does not yet exist

reliability_scopes_prepared_not_assigned.can_a_human_perform_the_five_field_revie: YES on both sides, from first-party methodology already shown to be retrievable
reliability_scopes_prepared_not_assigned.note: Two apparatuses on one proposition are TWO reliability scopes, because source_id is a scope field. One judgement cannot cover both, and that is correct: how dependably each measurement supports the proposition is a separate question for each measurer.

governance.$comment: Section 29 and 30. No review created, no source registered, no collector permission granted.
governance.commercial_position_recorded_separately: Both apparatuses are publicly funded research programmes whose outputs are ordinarily open, which makes a commercial-profile review plausible rather than established. Local-private permission would not imply it, and this mission asserts neither.
governance.why_this_is_pending_rather_than_blocked: Nothing was refused. No review has been asked for, which is an open question an operator can close, and section 8 of the source-registry rules distinguishes exactly that from a decision against.

next_mission_recommendation.name: Mission 1.58 — Independent Atmospheric Route Governance Review Preparation V1
next_mission_recommendation.why_governance_first: Section 50. The route's actionability is EPISTEMICALLY_VALID_GOVERNANCE_PENDING, and no threshold may be registered until the acquisition route is concrete enough to freeze the measurement contract. Registering a bound against a source nobody has reviewed would be freezing a contract for an acquisition that may never be permitted.
it_should: retrieve and read both producers' data-use terms first-party, including the terms for apparatus B which were not retrievable at the paths tried here
register both apparatuses as sources with their access profiles, without approving anything
perform the local-private-research-v1 policy review for each, on retrieved authoritative evidence
record the commercial-profile position separately and honestly
define the new record kind a mole-fraction observation needs, or establish that an existing kind fits
STOP before any acquisition, and before any threshold registration
it_must_not: fetch a measurement value, which would destroy the PREREGISTERED classification permanently
register the threshold before the acquisition contract is frozen
next_mission_recommendation.after_that: Mission 1.59 would freeze subject, metric, time, population and unit, register the PREREGISTERED threshold BEFORE either measurement is acquired, prepare both reliability-review scopes, and stop before network acquisition. That sequence is what produces the first genuinely preregistered deterministic threshold case rather than another POST_HOC held-data pilot.
